name: fixme-marketplace
description: FixMe.com — Find the Part. Fix the Device. Multi-vendor electronics spare-parts marketplace monorepo.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@fixme/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@fixme/validation && npm run build --workspace=@fixme/api-contracts
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@fixme/server && npm run build --workspace=@fixme/client && npm run build --workspace=@fixme/admin && npm run build --workspace=@fixme/seller
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fixme/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fixme/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fixme/admin && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fixme/seller
